code_summary: This script trains the incumbent FM+BPR+mean_pool_positives+lower_lr_longer configuration with train_lib primitives, then adds a custom inference-time score term `alpha * cosine(item_row_vector, user_positive_centroid)` built only from train-period positives. Existing menu primitives can train with pooled user history inside the model, but they cannot express deterministic post-hoc score adjustment using train-derived user/item embedding geometry after training. The fix is minimal: call the History API as a method and use its returned pooled vectors, preserving the original experiment.
